subject: Post-discovery: aligning demo window + capacity-sizing intake
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@finova.io>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@finova.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: aligning demo window + capacity-sizing intake

Hi Sanjay / Priya —

Great to meet earlier today — thanks for walking through Finova's fraud-flow and the tokenization patterns. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can lock the technical deep dive and sizing call: 

Summary from the call
- Primary objective: evaluate dedicated capacity to meet sub-100ms P50 and safe 99th-percentile latency targets for the fraud scoring pipeline at peak concurrency.
- Typical model workload: encoder-decoder hybrid with 1.2k token average prompt, occasional 8k-ticketed review flows.
- Key constraints: strict data residency in us-west, 3rd-party HSM for keys.

Next steps (proposed)
1) Technical deep dive / capacity-sizing (60–75 min): we’ll walk model IO, expected concurrency, and run a throughput projection to size a Dedicated GPU pool.
2) Product demo (30–45 min): focused on runtime knobs (batching, KV cache), routing policy examples, and the Redwood Optimize recommendations.
3) Pre-call intake: please complete the attached sizing template so we can prepare a tailored runbook.

Proposed windows (PT) for the technical deep dive next week — pick one or propose alternatives:
- Tue, Sep 28 — 10:00–11:15am PT
- Wed, Sep 29 — 2:00–3:15pm PT

I attached our sizing template and a short demo brief to help you prepare. Also dropping a tentative calendar link here — once you confirm a slot we’ll send a formal invite with the agenda and runbook owner assignments.

Attachments: redwood-sizing-template.xlsx, demo-brief.pdf

Thanks — we’ll have Marcus and Neha join the deep dive to run the throughput planning.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0127

Redwood Inference — production-grade LLM inference (hosted, dedicated, private)

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@finova.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finova.io>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: aligning demo window + capacity-sizing intake

Thanks, Kimberly —

Appreciate the clear recap. We definitely want the 60–75 min technical deep dive first. A couple quick clarifications before we lock a slot: 
- Will the session include a short walk-through of how KV caching would affect cold-starts for reviewer flows? We see a lot of variance there.
- For latency targets, we care about the 99th percentile more than P50 — do you typically provide P99 projections from your throughput model?

For availability, Tue, Sep 28 10:00am PT works well for our infra and fraud teams. We’ll try to get our infra lead (Priya) on the deep dive. I’ve attached a small traffic sample and a summary of our peak-hour concurrency (last 30 days).

Attachment: finova-traffic-sample.csv

If this slot is good on your side, please send the invite and let us know any additional artifacts you need completed before the call.

—Sanjay
Sanjay Rao
Director of Risk & Fraud | Finova
sanjay@finova.io | +1 (650) 222-9987

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@finova.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@finova.io>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: aligning demo window + capacity-sizing intake

Perfect — Tue 28 Sep 10:00am PT is good on our side. I created a tentative calendar event (link below) and attached a short pre-call checklist so we can make the session productive:

Confirmed slot: Tue, Sep 28 — 10:00–11:15am PT
Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-finova-sizing-20270928

Agenda draft:
- 10:00–10:10 — quick introductions + goals (Kimberly)
- 10:10–10:35 — workload profile & tokenization deep dive (Marcus)
- 10:35–11:00 — throughput projection and Dedicated pool recommendations (Neha)
- 11:00–11:15 — Q&A, next steps and action items

Pre-call asks
- Please drop the completed redwood-sizing-template.xlsx into the Drive folder (link below) — ideal fields: peak concurrency, p50/p95/p99 latencies observed, payload sizes, auth pattern.
- If you can, include a short list of 3 example requests (anonymized) to help us validate batch size sensitivity.

Attachments: pre-call-checklist.md (brief)
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-finova

Looking forward — Marcus will bring the KV/cache examples, and Neha will run the capacity projection. If you need to shift the slot by 30–45 minutes, say so and we’ll adapt.

Best,
Kimberly
